Three currently **open** issues in `vercel/next.js` discussing memory leaks involving Turbopack:

3. [#83275 — Server is approaching the used memory threshold, restarting…](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/83275): Repeated development-server memory exhaustion; discussion includes Turbopack memory leaks, though the report covers broader memory problems.
